page_title: EIN 3-3 DOR | Eintracht Frankfurt v Dortmund 09/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Referee Daniel Schlager points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) goes wild in celebration.
90+7' Wait! Referee Daniel Schlager has indicated he is going to review the Dortmund goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
90+6' 3 - 3 Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) scores from a quite difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the left post. Excellent finish.
90+4' It's a throw-in for Dortmund.
90+2' 3 - 2 Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets to a rebound just outside the penalty area and unleashes a fabulous effort that goes in off the right post.
90+1' OFF THE BAR! Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) outjumps the defence to connect with the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but his effort only crashes against the crossbar.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Dortmund will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
87' Julian Brandt goes off the pitch and Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) comes on.
87' Emre Can (Dortmund) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
86' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
86' Eintracht Frankfurt enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
85' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a long ball in, but Kaua Santos comfortably gathers the ball.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) is coming onto the pitch as Arthur Theate cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) was quite harsh and Daniel Schlager didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' A pass from Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) is intercepted by Kaua Santos and the move breaks down.
80' A corner kick by Dortmund is thwarted by the well prepared Kaua Santos (Eintracht Frankfurt).
78' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) trips an opposition player and Daniel Schlager signals a foul.
77' It is time for a substitution. Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) is on for Oscar Hojlund.
77' Substitution. Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) on for Ansgar Knauff.
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Niklas Sule as he is replaced by Emre Can (Dortmund).
76' Niko Kovac has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) replacing Maximilian Beier.
75' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kaua Santos, who smothers the ball.

74' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Kaua Santos pulls off an easy save.
73' The attendance is 59500.

71' 2 - 2 Goal! Great play by Arnaud Kalimuendo releases Younes Ebnoutalib (Eintracht Frankfurt) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the top of the net. 2:2.
68' 1 - 2 Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) gets to a rebound just outside the penalty area and unleashes a fabulous low effort that goes in off the left post.
67' Daniel Schlager shows a yellow card to Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.
66' Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Serhou Guirassy is replaced by Fabio Silva (Dortmund).
65' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
65' Dortmund control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
63' Substitution. Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) in, Can Yilmaz Uzun out.
62' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.

59' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) displays brilliant awareness inside the box to pounce on the rebound. From a difficult position he directs a header towards the middle of the net, but Kaua Santos pulls off a decent save to deny him.
58' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
56' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a reproachful look from Younes Ebnoutalib. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
56' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kaua Santos intercepts the ball.

55' Gregor Kobel makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom right corner.
54' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
52' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) decides to take on the shot from mid-range after a rebound, but he fails to connect properly with the ball and the effort sails harmlessly wide of the left post.
51' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
49' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

47' Chance! Hugo Larsson sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Younes Ebnoutalib (Eintracht Frankfurt), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Dortmund are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
43' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) has tested the patience of referee Daniel Schlager and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
41' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) gets a yellow card.

40' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the free kick. The attempt goes down towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that.
37' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
37' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
36' Dortmund play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
32' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but Kaua Santos comes off his line to gather the ball.
29' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
27' Poor challenge! Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised for tripping and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle.
26' The resulting corner from Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
26' Dortmund can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' 1 - 1 Goal! Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Gregor Kobel into the bottom left corner.
22' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
20' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for an infringement. No point in arguing there. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a penalty kick.
19' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
19' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Gregor Kobel makes a smart save to deny him.
18' The corner is swung in but Eintracht Frankfurt can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

17' That was a nice football moment. Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Gregor Kobel guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
16' A long ball forward to Younes Ebnoutalib (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted.
14' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes.
13' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
10' 0 - 1 Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) meets a perfect cross from Julian Ryerson deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
8' Eintracht Frankfurt are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
7' The ball is behind the touchline and Eintracht Frankfurt will take a throw-in.
4' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
3' The Dortmund players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' The ball is behind the sideline. Niklas Sule (Dortmund) takes a throw-in.
1' The match has just started.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick-off.
Daniel Schlager got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
